next.reason: 1985: 'Data description entries subordinate to a CD, FD, or SD entry must have level-numbers'; 2023: 'Data description entries subordinate to a FD or SD entry shall have level-numbers with the values 66, 88, or 1 through 49.'. Values 01-49, 66 and 88 are kept for FD/SD (the level-2 box is no difference). The CD case is dropped: no 2023 candidate covers entries subordinate to a CD.
